mapper.select: select id, role_name, role_code, description, is_enabled, create_time from blog_role where deleted_at = 0 and id = #{id}
mapper.insert: insert into blog_role (role_name, role_code, description, is_enabled, deleted_at, create_time, update_time) values (#{roleName}, #{roleCode}, #{description}, #{isEnabled}, 0, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: update blog_role set role_name = #{roleName}, role_code = #{roleCode}, description = #{description}, is_enabled = #{isEnabled}, update_time = NOW() where deleted_at = 0 and id = #{id}
update blog_role set deleted_at = #{deletedAt}, update_time = NOW() where deleted_at = 0 and id = #{id}
mapper.select: select count(*) from blog_user_role where deleted_at = 0 and role_id = #{id}
select m.id from blog_role_menu rm inner join blog_menu m on rm.menu_id = m.id and m.deleted_at = 0 and m.is_enabled = 1 where rm.deleted_at = 0 and rm.role_id = #{roleId}
select ur.user_id from blog_user_role ur where ur.deleted_at = 0 and ur.role_id = #{roleId}
mapper.insert:
insert into blog_role_menu (role_id, menu_id, deleted_at, create_time, update_time) values
(#{roleId}, #{menuId}, 0, NOW(), NOW())
on duplicate key update deleted_at = 0, update_time = NOW()
mapper.select: select ap.id from blog_role_api_permission rap inner join blog_api_permission ap on rap.api_permission_id = ap.id and ap.deleted_at = 0 and ap.is_enabled = 1 where rap.deleted_at = 0 and rap.role_id = #{roleId}

insert into blog_role_api_permission (role_id, api_permission_id, deleted_at, create_time, update_time) values
